01What this object holds

Type
object
Full path
/electron-persisted-atom-state
Meaning

Persisted renderer atom store containing desktop preferences, restoration state, workflow continuations and service caches.

Behavior

The desktop synchronizes renderer atoms with the host settings store; atom-specific schemas, migrations and owners determine how each value is used.

Evidence
bundle [snapshot]; [Bf834e239]
Limits

This is a private desktop implementation snapshot, not a stable public session API. No primitive values are shown.
